outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official completed evaluations have the same failed outcome, 157/163 samples passed. The parallel-profile run did not actually execute parallel child work, so the task-solving contrast is between two single-actor implementations with different local probing and helper APIs, not between a parallel coordination failure and a serial success.
parallel_contributors: Main actor implemented all files itself and verified only samples, one negative case, and two error paths before finalizing.
Protocol validation and raw trajectory show no executed child, handoff, merge, or parallel shared-state event.
serial_contributors: Main actor probed executable behavior before writing and tested more edge cases, including correcting the verification harness exit-code capture.
Serial still produced the same official failed score as parallel, so broader local verification did not yield an official pass.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a separate pyformat helper and `contains`/`inv.contains`; serial used an ArgumentParser class and `hasKey`/`inv.has`.
Serial verification covered more executable-observed edge cases, but hidden testcase details are not mounted, so the exact six failed cases cannot be reconstructed.
